sources.entry: BookLogr - Manage your personal book library with ease. (Demo) Apache-2.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: BookLogr is a self-hosted web app for tracking your personal book library, including books you own, have read, or want to read.
summary.what_it_does: BookLogr lets you look up books by title or ISBN using OpenLibrary and add them to predefined lists: Reading, Already Read, To Be Read, and Did not finish. You can manually add books that OpenLibrary does not have. It supports tracking your current page while reading, rating books on a 0.5 to 5-star scale, and saving short notes and quotes. An optional public profile lets you share your library with others. Data can be exported as CSV, JSON, or HTML, and the app uses SQLite by default with PostgreSQL as an alternative.
use_cases: share a public book library with friends
how_to_run: Follow the Getting Started guide in the project docs (linked from the README)
notable: Automatically shares reading progress to Mastodon
Looks up books by ISBN or title via OpenLibrary, with manual entry fallback
Optional public profile for sharing a library
Exports to CSV, JSON, and HTML
caveats: README warns the project is under active development, with bugs and breaking changes expected
Setup details are only in the external Getting Started guide and wiki, not the README
keywords: keep track of books i own
